key_insight: SAE-Audit improves clinical-trial outcome predictions by giving black-box LLMs concept-level evidence derived from an open model.
clinical_relevance: More accurate predictions of trial completion or early termination could support research planning, but do not establish treatment safety or efficacy.
method: Convert a frozen sparse autoencoder on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct into a vocabulary of clinical concepts.
Fit sparse probes on past trials to identify outcome-associated concepts.
Provide detected concepts and their association direction and strength to guide the target LLM’s answer.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports balanced-accuracy gains of 9.6–12.0 percentage points for deepseek-v4-flash across five trial-prediction tasks and 8.0 points for GPT-5.6-terra on trial completion.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify dataset sizes or external validation, leaving generalizability to new trial settings uncertain.
paper_title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
